verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page documents per-plan monthly search quotas: Free at 250 searches/month and a Cloud 1M tier at 1,000,000 searches, with a second unlabeled figure of 110,000. It also describes a self-serve path: "start for free, upgrade as you grow", month-to-month billing and Automatic Early Renewal when searches run out. However, the evidence does not show explicit per-second or hourly rate limits or concurrency caps, which are the core of the story. Missing for 10: clearly labeled rate limits such as per-hour throughput, documented concurrency caps, behavior when a limit is hit (e.g. 429 handling), and independent corroboration of the upgrade flow.
